purpose: Read the within-depot percentage for each of 16 cell subtypes in three depots. Use a compact tall heatmap with decoded numerical scale and retain observed zeros.
mechanism: matrix-shaped compact cells and decoded sequential scale
expected_benefit: Unique subtype aliases free enough physical width for three columns; every two-decimal label fits its cell, and the colorbar decodes the linear 0–40% scale.
observed_tradeoff: Pass 1 full-label geometry caused numerical label overlap. Pass 2 fixed geometry but rounded the smallest positive value to 0.0. Pass 3 shows 0.04, preserving the positive/zero distinction.
record_timing: Purpose, roles, actual burden and concrete geometry were planned in create-intent.json, initial spec.json and agent working notes before first rendering; this durable summary was consolidated after bounded image review.
